scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix riven
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix riven && npm run typecheck --prefix riven
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix riven
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:workflow --prefix riven
scripts.audit:all: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix backend --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix riven --audit-level=high
scripts.check: npm run check:repository && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
